releases.name: v0.1.2 — Remote browser sign-in
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added **Remote browser sign-in** for Magpie running on a server, NAS, or in Docker while the browser runs on another machine.
- Exposes the loopback callback address in the login URL's plain query so Magpie can offer its **Callback URL** field, while retaining the portal-required hash parameters.
- Existing browser sign-in and desktop account import remain available.
- Updated the English and Chinese sign-in documentation and added regression coverage.

## Validation

- `bun test`: **79 passed, 0 failed** (189 assertions).
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Thanks

Thanks to @isdoge for contributing #1!

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Jasery/opencode-lobster-auth/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
